title: Chapter 288 Extraordinary Status
content:
Chapter 288 Extraordinary Status

"What exactly is Lu Daosheng, Lord of Huangcheng City?"

Chu Lingsheng's eyes were lost and he murmured.

This terrifying binding force is many times stronger than the Oath of Heaven.

From beginning to end, he remotely controlled his clone to do everything, and he basically never showed up in public.

And this time, it was the first time that his original body was threatened.

At that moment, as long as he had a slight desire to resist, he would be wiped out.

Thinking of this, Chu Lingsheng was a little scared.

Sure enough, the oath cannot be made casually.

Zhuyun Peak.

Chu Lingsheng also barely came back to his senses.

When he looked at Lu Xuezhi again, the pride in his eyes gradually became restrained.

"Who is this Huangcheng City Lord?"

Chu Lingsheng asked.

Lu Xue naturally would not tell him about this.

"You just need to know that he is an existence that you can't imagine. Bear your oath."

Lu Xue smiled and then turned around and walked towards Xiao Luo.

At this time, Xiao Luo had already swallowed a recovery pill, and his injuries just now were no longer seriously injured.

"Sister Xue, I'm fine."

Seeing Lu Xue walking towards him, Xiao Luo felt a little moved.

"Uh, I want to say, when will we set out?"

Xiao Luo:...

After a moment.

Four figures left the Tiandi Academy at an extremely fast speed.

Xiao Luo led the way in the front, Lu Xue and Qin Feng followed closely, while Chu Lingsheng followed silently at the end.

None of the three said anything about this.

This guy seems to be socially terrified. He has never seen him himself yet.

"Xiao Luo, what is the origin of the ancient battlefield?"

Qin Feng suddenly asked at this time.

Upon hearing this, Xiao Luo's expression slightly condensed and he whispered: "You should have heard the legend about the origin of the Immortal Realm, right?"

Origin of the Immortal Realm!

Qin Feng's face was shocked, as if he had guessed something.

Only Lu Xue was a little confused.

What is the origin of the fairyland?

Compared to Lu Daosheng who read a lot of books, Lu Xue basically does not read books.

So she has only a few understandings of many things, or has never heard of them at all.

At this time, Xiao Luo continued, "That's right, a long time ago, there was no such area as the Immortal Realm."

"Until later, the fairyland suddenly appeared in the center of the fairyland. The fairy light filled the sky, and countless amazing auras spread out from it, attracting top powerhouses everywhere in the fairyland."

"It is said that in that era, there were many immortal saints as dogs, and the immortal emperor was walking all over the ground. Even the legendary immortal emperor often appeared in the human world."

"So, did those strong people break out in a war to compete for resources in the Immortal Realm?"

Qin Feng spoke.

Upon hearing this, Xiao Luo nodded, "It's even recorded in ancient books."

"That battle was extremely tragic. Many immortal emperors fell there. It was blood flowing into a river, and the killing aura was everywhere. After time passed, the battlefield gradually calmed down, and finally formed an independent world, hidden in the immortal world. In the long river of time.”

"This is the ancient battlefield."

After hearing what Xiao Luo said, Lu Xue and the others immediately understood the horror of this ancient battlefield.

There may be many terrifying corpses inside.

There will be many residual killer moves that have not dissipated.

In this case,

"We don't even have the Immortal Emperor Realm. Isn't it that I'm asking for death when I go in?"

Luxue Road.

Yes, the ancient battlefield is so terrifying, at least you need to have the strength of the Immortal Emperor Realm to enter the exploration.

As he said that, Lu Xue glanced behind him intentionally or unintentionally.

Chu Lingsheng is just right.

Lu Xue's words made Qin Feng nod agreeably.

He is still in the middle stage of the Immortal Saint Realm. Although he is still confident and powerful in the early stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm, he is still a bit inadequate to explore this ancient battlefield.

"I said Xiao Luo, you kid don't want to kill us and inherit our legacy, right?"

Qin Feng joked.

These words immediately made Xiao Luo burst into tears.

"Damn it, don't fart, okay!"

Then Xiao Luo quickly looked at Lu Xue and said a little aggrievedly: "Sister Xue, you have to believe me, I definitely didn't think so."

As he said that, Xiao Luo was about to swear, "I, Xiao Luo, go to Huangcheng City,"

Before he could finish his words, Lu Xue interrupted him.

"Oh, okay, okay, hurry up and talk about the key points!"

"oh."

Xiao Luo coughed lightly and said, "This ancient battlefield is dangerous. It is estimated that it will be difficult for us who are not as powerful as the Immortal Emperor Realm to get out alive."

"However, this ancient battlefield is also divided into regions. Only the internal central area of the ancient battlefield is truly full of dangers, and it is also full of great opportunities. Even some late-stage strong men in the Immortal Emperor Realm have the opportunity to be there."

"So, we just need to be on the periphery and picking up some junk is enough for us to improve our strength."

Hearing this, Lu Xue and the others also understood.

If you have poor strength, just on the periphery. If you have strong strength, just go inside.

"Then wouldn't that guy just enter the center of the ancient battlefield?"

Qin Feng pointed at Chu Lingsheng behind him and said.

In response, Xiao Luo nodded, "Theory is this."

"Then how can he protect us?"

"You are stupid. When you improve your strength to the Immortal Emperor realm, you will be able to walk inside."

"Well, that's right."

In this way, the four of them traveled day and night, and after several days, they finally arrived, Xiao clan.

"Fuck, isn't this your family?!"

"Don't tell me, the ancient battlefield is really in your house!"

Several people stood in front of the Xiao clan's gate, and Qin Feng roared a little.

Upon hearing this, Xiao Luo's face turned slightly red, "Although my Xiao family has a great career, it has not yet reached the point where he can enjoy the ancient battlefield alone."

"If you want to enter the ancient battlefield, of course, I, the strong man of Xiao clan, have to be taken over by me."

That's it.

Qin Feng calmed down.

This is reasonable.

And at this moment, there was movement in the Xiao clan.

The next moment, several terrifying auras soared into the sky and came straight towards the four of them.

The person in charge is Xiao Luo's grandfather, Xiao Mo.

"grandfather!"

Seeing Xiao Mo, Xiao Luo looked overjoyed and rushed up quickly.

Xiao Mo also looked a little excited, and saw Xiao Mo quickly step forward and the two of them rushed in both directions.

"grandfather!!"

Looking at the scene of the grandfather-grandson reunion after a long separation, Qin Feng sniffed without saying a word.

But the next moment, he was stunned.

Xiao Mo directly skipped Xiao Luo and came straight to Lu Xue.

"Xiao Mo, the leader of the Xiao clan, has met Miss Lu."

Xiao Mo saluted Lu Xue with a respectful salute, and immediately shocked Qin Feng.

Damn, what's the situation!

Not far away, Xiao Luo was stiff all over the place.

Just now, my biological grandfather passed by me.

Who am I and where am I?

Looking at the respectful expression of the Xiao clan leader in front of him, Lu Xue was also a little surprised.

"Old Xiao, you don't need to be too polite."

Lu Xue hurriedly stepped forward and held Xiao Mo up.

Obviously, Xiao Mo attaches great importance to Lu Xue.

Even surpassed his grandson.

"We've seen Miss Lu."

At this time, several powerful men behind Xiao Mo also stepped forward.

Lu Xue sighed and said nothing.

But speaking of this, I can indeed be considered kind to the Xiao clan.

Of course, it’s more because of my invincible father.
